luwu.trace.server.markdownDescription: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Luwu language server.

luwu.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the Luau LSP server binary. If not provided, uses the binary included in the extension.

luwu.server.communicationChannel.markdownDescription: Type of communication channel to use for communicating with the server. Only useful for debug purposes
enumDescriptions: Communicate via UNIX socket files. Useful for debugging

luwu.server.delayStartup.markdownDescription: Make the server spin indefinitely when starting up to allow time to attach a debugger. Only useful for debug purposes

luwu.server.baseLuaurc.markdownDescription: Path to a `.luaurc` file which acts as the default baseline Luau configuration

luwu.fileExtensions.markdownDescription:
The file extensions this language server is responsible for. Remove `lua` and `luau` to leave those files to a different language server; `.luwu` files are always Luwu's own. Requires still resolve across extensions either way, so a `.luwu` module can require a `.luau` one.

Requires a reload of the language server to take effect.

luwu.ignoreGlobs.markdownDescription: Diagnostics will not be reported for any file matching these globs unless the file is currently open

luwu.sourcemap.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether Rojo sourcemap parsing is enabled

luwu.sourcemap.autogenerate.markdownDescription: Automatically run the `rojo sourcemap` command to regenerate sourcemaps on changes

luwu.sourcemap.rojoPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Rojo executable. If not provided, attempts to run `rojo` in the workspace directory, so it must be available on the PATH

luwu.sourcemap.rojoProjectFile.markdownDescription:
The name of the Rojo project file to generate a sourcemap for.
Only applies if `#luwu.sourcemap.autogenerate#` is enabled

luwu.sourcemap.includeNonScripts.markdownDescription: Include non-script instances in the generated sourcemap

luwu.sourcemap.sourcemapFile.markdownDescription: The name of the sourcemap file

luwu.sourcemap.generatorCommand.markdownDescription: A command to run to generate the sourcemap. If not specified, defaults to `rojo`

luwu.sourcemap.useVSCodeWatcher.markdownDescription: Whether the VSCode filesystem watchers are used to regenerate the sourcemap. If disabled, delegates to the generator process. If using `rojo`, this command stops using `--watch`

luwu.format.convertQuotes.markdownDescription: Whether to automatically convert single/double quotes to backticks when typing `{` inside strings

luwu.format.bracketAttributeArguments.markdownDescription: Whether to rewrite a bare attribute to its bracketed form when typing `{` after it, since only the bracketed form takes arguments: `@deprecated {` becomes `@[deprecated {}]`. Needs `editor.formatOnType`.

luwu.fflags.enableByDefault.markdownDescription: Enable all (boolean) Luau FFlags by default. These flags can later be overriden by `#luwu.fflags.override#` and `#luwu.fflags.sync#`

luwu.fflags.enableNewSolver.markdownDescription: Enables the flags required for Luau's new type solver. These flags can be overriden by `#luwu.fflags.override#`

luwu.luauCompatibilityMode.markdownDescription: Luau compatibility mode: disable Luwu's own language features (classes, default arguments, ...)

luwu.fflags.sync.markdownDescription:
Sync currently enabled FFlags with Roblox's published FFlags.
This currently only syncs FFlags which begin with 'Luau'

luwu.diagnostics.includeDependents.markdownDescription: Recompute diagnostics for dependents when a file changes. If `#luwu.diagnostics.workspace#` is enabled, this is ignored

luwu.diagnostics.workspace.markdownDescription: Compute diagnostics for the whole workspace

luwu.diagnostics.strictDatamodelTypes.markdownDescription: Use strict DataModel types in diagnostics. When on, this is equivalent to the more expressive autocompletion types. When this is off, `game`/`script`/`workspace` (and their members) are all typed as `any`, and helps to prevent false positives. [Read More](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/luau-lsp/issues/83#issuecomment-1192865024)

luwu.diagnostics.pullOnChange.markdownDescription: Whether to update document diagnostics whenever the text file changes

luwu.diagnostics.pullOnSave.markdownDescription: Whether to update document diagnostics whenever the text file is saved

luwu.types.definitionFiles.markdownDescription: A mapping of package names to paths of definition files to load in to the type checker. Note that definition file syntax is currently unstable and may change at any time

luwu.types.documentationFiles.markdownDescription: A list of paths to documentation files which provide documentation support to the definition files provided

luwu.types.disabledGlobals.markdownDescription: A list of globals to remove from the global scope. Accepts full libraries or particular functions (e.g., `table` or `table.clone`)

luwu.types.roblox.markdownDescription: Load in and automatically update Roblox type definitions for the type checker

luwu.types.robloxSecurityLevel.markdownDescription: Security Level to use in the Roblox API definitions

luwu.inlayHints.hideHintsForMatchingPara.markdownDescription: Whether type hints should be hidden if the resolved variable name matches the parameter name

luwu.inlayHints.typeHintMaxLength.markdownDescription: The maximum length a type hint should be before being truncated

luwu.inlayHints.makeInsertable.markdownDescription: Whether type annotation inlay hints can be made insertable by clicking

luwu.inheritLuauLspSettings.markdownDescription:
Read settings written under the legacy `luau-lsp.*` namespace, which this extension used before it was renamed and which external tooling still generates. A `luwu.*` setting always wins over its `luau-lsp.*` counterpart.

Turn this off to ignore `luau-lsp.*` entirely, which is what you want if upstream's Luau Language Server is installed alongside this one and you need the two configured separately.

walkthroughs.title: Getting Started with Luau
walkthroughs.description: An initial setup guide for the Luau Language Server

steps.title: Select your Platform
steps.description:
This extension provides out-of-the-box support for Roblox projects. If you are working in a separate environment, you may want to set your platform to ``standard``
[Configure Platform](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22luwu.platform.type%22)

steps.title: Register Custom Definitions
steps.description:
If you work in an environment with custom global definitions, you can register these types to support type-checking and autocomplete
[Configure Type Definitions](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22luwu.types%22)

steps.title: Configure Sourcemap Generation
steps.description:
A sourcemap provides a mapping between your paths on the file system to locations in the Roblox DataModel. By default, we automatically generate sourcemaps based on [Rojo](https://github.com/rojo-rbx/rojo) projects.
[Configure Sourcemap Generation](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22luwu.sourcemap%22)

steps.title: Install the Companion Plugin
steps.description:
A companion plugin is available in Roblox Studio. This allows type-checking and autocomplete to work on Instances that are only available in Studio, and not on your file system
[Install Companion Plugin](https://www.roblox.com/library/10913122509/Luau-Language-Server-Companion)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
